Constraints / Stub generator
* Please change 12 to 10.

Cases
* Please revise the cases so that each test and its corresponding validator cover the *same scenario* using slightly different inputs and, wherever possible, slightly different expected outputs.

* Please use input strings containing completely random digits, rather than relying on repeated digits or digits arranged in arithmetic progressions.

* Please ensure that every digit appears in at least one test and at least one validator. Currently,

  • Digits 0 and 8 don't appear in any tests.

  • Digits 0 and 9 don't appear in any validators.

* Please ensure a wider variety of expected outputs.

Thanks.
